❓ Frequently asked questions

How is Kelvin converted to a color?

With the standard Tanner Helland approximation of blackbody radiation: separate formulas map temperature to red, green and blue channels, clamped to 0–255.

How accurate is the approximation?

Very close for 2000K–6500K. Above ~8000K the blue channel saturates, so extreme values are indicative rather than exact.

What do the labels mean?

Warm (<3300K: cozy amber light), neutral (3300–5300K: daylight-ish white), cool (>5300K: bluish daylight). Photographers white-balance around these.
